blockingIssues.description: packages/agent/tests/test-harness.spec.ts uses Bun.spawn with hardcoded cwd '/tmp/fix-eager-send/packages/agent' (line 276), making the test non-portable and prone to failure outside this local path (e.g., CI and other clones).

Feature was marked successful even though its own evidence reported full-suite failure (exitCode 1, 2 failed tests, and '# Unhandled error between tests'), which does not satisfy its acceptance criteria.

appliedUpdates.description: Updated .factory/library/user-testing.md with guidance that forbidden-string grep on full logs can match test titles and create false positives; added recommendation to anchor on runtime diagnostics and corroborate context.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Reconcile commit workflow guidance with mission policy: support single-commit TDD when mission AGENTS.md requires one commit per feature.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Two reviewer reports flagged conflict between SKILL.md RED/GREEN commit steps and mission AGENTS.md one-commit rule; feature history shows split test/fix commits caused by this mismatch.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Relax strict RED-phase wording to allow dependency-followup features where newly-added assertions may already pass because prerequisite features landed first; require explicit documentation instead of forced failure.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Review for deflake-existing-eager-send-tests-and-cross-integration reported that some intended RED tests can pass immediately once tracker/harness features are already merged.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Normalize precedence rules for known pre-existing failures versus strict full-suite pass criteria so validators can make deterministic pass/fail decisions.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Review for flake-regression-guard-end-to-end identified contradictory guidance across mission files: strict 0-fail acceptance in feature metadata versus known baseline hook-timeout exceptions in AGENTS.md.
